descriptionChirho: Abstract moral or divine goodness as a quality or attribute, often predicated of God or of persons.
Concrete good things, material goods, produce, or possessions — the tangible benefits or bounty of a land or situation.
A state of flourishing, welfare, or prosperity enjoyed by a person or group.
Physical beauty, attractiveness, or splendor of appearance, as of a land or person.
Joy, gladness, or festive happiness arising from abundance or blessing.
